main_text.p: [Hebrew/Syriac word] Syr. Contritio, ad Rom. 3. 16. Attritio, conflictatio, disputatio molesta, 1. ad Timoth. 6. 5.
[Hebrew word] Ch. Coelum, æther, Psal. 89. 7. 38. Pl. [Hebrew plural]
[Hebrew word] Ch. Mane, tempestive, diluculo, sedulo quaerere, requirere, pervestigare: Deinde [Syriac word] Syriac. est Angariare, cogere, vi adigere, Praeterit.
Part. [Syriac word] Qui angariatte, cap. 5. 41. Hinc accipere, auferre vi, Numer. 16. 15. 1. Sam. 12. 3.

Pabel [Hebrew word] Idem. Ethp. Syr. [Syriac word] Relinqui, residuum, reliquum, superstitem manere. Idem quod Ch. [Hebrew word] mutato in ה pro more, ad Rom. 11. 3. 5. 1. Thess. 4. 15. Item ex forma quadrata, [Syriac word] Morari, cunctari, tardare: tardari, retardari, Actor. 20. 16. & 22. 16. [Syriac word] Qui differimur, absque o, 1. ad Thess. 4. 15. 16. Hoc est ab [Hebrew word], praepositio ∨ ab initio.
[Hebrew word] Ch. Dimittere liberum, manumittere, libertate donare, Genes. 30. 4. & 9. in Targ. Jon. Quadratum ex חרר. Ithpah. Manumitti, Libertate donari, Exo. 21. 7. in Jon.
